title: Seventh Word Conclusion Counsel On Prayer Avoiding Major Sins Listening To The Quran And Supplication

questions.question: What is the first main request made to Allah at the beginning of this passage?
questions.answer: It asks Allah to fill the hearts of believers with the light of faith and the Qur’an.

questions.question: In the prayer, what kind of richness is being requested from Allah?
questions.answer: A richness that comes from recognizing one’s need for Allah.

questions.question: What kind of poverty is being rejected in the prayer?
questions.answer: The poverty that comes from acting as if one does not need Allah.

questions.question: What does the passage ask Allah to help people turn away from in themselves?
questions.answer: Their own limited strength and power.

questions.question: What does it ask Allah to help them rely on instead?
questions.answer: Allah’s strength and power.

questions.question: According to the prayer, what does true trust in Allah include besides saying words of trust?
questions.answer: It includes not being left to one’s own self.

questions.question: What two protections are directly asked from Allah for the believers?
questions.answer: His guarding care and His mercy.

questions.question: Who is included in the prayer for mercy besides the speaker?
questions.answer: All believing men and women.

questions.question: How is Prophet Muhammad described in relation to Allah before the long list of honors begins?
questions.answer: As Allah’s servant, prophet, friend, and beloved.

questions.question: What do the many titles for Prophet Muhammad show about his status in this passage?
questions.answer: They show that he is honored in many ways and has a central role in guidance, mercy, and conveying Allah’s message.

questions.question: Which descriptions show that Prophet Muhammad helps people understand divine truth?
questions.answer: He is presented as one who explains the signs of Allah, teaches the servants of Allah, and makes known the treasures of the divine names.

questions.question: Which phrase shows that Prophet Muhammad was sent with a mission for all creation, not only one group?
questions.answer: He is described as being sent as a mercy to all worlds.

questions.question: Besides the Prophet, his family, and his companions, who else receives blessings or peace in this prayer?
questions.answer: His brother prophets and messengers, the near angels, and the righteous servants of Allah.

questions.question: What major themes hold the whole prayer together?
questions.answer: Faith, dependence on Allah, protection, mercy, and honoring the Prophet and the righteous.

questions.question: What does the opening of the passage ask Allah to do for human hearts?
questions.answer: Make them bright with faith and with the guidance of the Qur’an.

questions.question: How does the prayer connect spiritual wealth with neediness?
questions.answer: It treats needing Allah as the real form of richness.

questions.question: What attitude toward personal ability is taught in this prayer?
questions.answer: A person should not depend on his own power but should admit weakness and seek help from Allah.

questions.question: How does the prayer define the safest condition for a believer?
questions.answer: Being among those who trust Allah and are not left to themselves.

questions.question: What does the request for protection suggest about human beings?
questions.answer: They are vulnerable and need Allah’s guarding care.

questions.question: What does the prayer for mercy upon believing men and women show about the speaker’s concern?
questions.answer: It shows care for the whole believing community, not just oneself.

questions.question: Why are so many honorable descriptions given for Prophet Muhammad in this passage?
questions.answer: To show his high rank and many roles in guiding creation to Allah.

questions.question: What role of Prophet Muhammad is emphasized by calling him a teacher and interpreter?
questions.answer: He helps people understand Allah’s signs and learn how to live by them.

questions.question: What role is emphasized by describing him as a model of mercy?
questions.answer: He reflects divine mercy in a way people can recognize and follow.

questions.question: What does the description of him as a light and lamp suggest?
questions.answer: He brings guidance and helps remove darkness and confusion.

questions.question: How does the passage describe Prophet Muhammad’s relationship to the rest of creation?
questions.answer: He is shown as one of the greatest and most honored beings among creation.

questions.question: What groups near the end of the prayer show the wide circle of those remembered?
questions.answer: The Prophet’s family, companions, other prophets, angels, and righteous servants.

questions.question: What is the overall tone of this passage?
questions.answer: It is humble, loving, reverent, and full of du‘a.

questions.question: What is the central purpose of this passage as a whole?
questions.answer: It is a supplication asking Allah for guidance, dependence, protection, mercy, and blessings upon His chosen servants.

questions.question: How does the prayer show that faith is connected to light?
questions.answer: It asks for hearts to be illuminated by belief and the Qur’an.

questions.question: In this passage, what is better than feeling self-sufficient?
questions.answer: Feeling in need of Allah.

questions.question: What contrast is made between two inner conditions of a person?
questions.answer: One condition is knowing one’s need for Allah, and the other is pretending not to need Him.

questions.question: What does the prayer ask believers to be cleared of regarding themselves?
questions.answer: Confidence in their own independent power and strength.

questions.question: What replacement for self-reliance does the prayer seek?
questions.answer: Refuge in Allah’s power and strength.

questions.question: What does the line about not being entrusted to ourselves imply about the human self?
questions.answer: The self is not reliable enough to be left alone without divine help.

questions.question: What balance appears in the requests made after trust is mentioned?
questions.answer: The prayer asks both for protection and for mercy.

questions.question: How is Prophet Muhammad linked to beauty and order in creation through the titles used for him?
questions.answer: He is described with titles that connect him to divine artistry, favor, guidance, and the meaningfulness of creation.

questions.question: Which descriptions present Prophet Muhammad as someone who communicates Allah’s message clearly?
questions.answer: He is shown as the one who announces what pleases Allah, proclaims the treasures of His names, and explains His signs.

questions.question: What does calling him a mirror suggest in this religious context?
questions.answer: It suggests that he reflects divine beauty and lordship in a clear and pure way.

questions.question: What does the phrase about being sent as mercy indicate about his mission?
questions.answer: His mission was meant to bring compassion and benefit widely.

questions.question: Why might the prayer mention prophets, angels, and righteous servants together at the end?
questions.answer: To place the prayer within the wider community of those close to Allah and obedient to Him.

questions.question: What can a student learn from the structure of this prayer about making du‘a?
questions.answer: A du‘a can begin with personal need, expand to the whole believing community, and include salawat upon the Prophet and prayers for the righteous.

questions.question: What two sources are named as bringing light to the heart?
questions.answer: Faith and the Qur’an.

questions.question: How does the passage redefine what it means to be truly enriched?
questions.answer: True enrichment comes from needing Allah, not from acting independent of Him.

questions.question: What spiritual danger is connected with claiming independence from Allah?
questions.answer: It leaves a person inwardly poor.

questions.question: What confession about human ability is found in this prayer?
questions.answer: Human strength and power are not enough on their own.

questions.question: What action follows that confession in the prayer?
questions.answer: Taking refuge in Allah’s strength and power.

questions.question: According to this du‘a, what should happen instead of being left to one’s own self?
questions.answer: A person should be made among those who rely on Allah.

questions.question: What does the request for divine protection tell us about the believer’s relationship with Allah?
questions.answer: The believer depends on Allah for safety and preservation.

questions.question: What does including all believing men and women in the prayer teach about Islamic character?
questions.answer: A Muslim should care about the well-being of the whole ummah.

questions.question: What kinds of qualities of Prophet Muhammad are highlighted in this passage: only personal virtues, or also mission-related qualities?
questions.answer: Both his noble personal rank and his mission of guidance are highlighted.

questions.question: Give one example of a title that presents Prophet Muhammad as a guide.
questions.answer: He is described as a sun of guidance.

questions.question: Give one example of a title that presents Prophet Muhammad as a messenger of divine truth.
questions.answer: He is described as an interpreter of the signs of Allah.

questions.question: What does the phrase about all worlds suggest about the reach of the Prophet’s mercy?
questions.answer: It is universal in scope.

questions.question: How does the ending widen the prayer beyond one single person?
questions.answer: It extends blessings and peace to the Prophet’s family, companions, other prophets, angels, and righteous servants.

questions.question: What spiritual change is requested for the heart in the opening line?
questions.answer: The heart is asked to be filled with divine light through faith and the Qur’an.

questions.question: What is the difference between the two conditions of need mentioned in the passage?
questions.answer: One is blessed neediness toward Allah, and the other is the false sense of not needing Him.

questions.question: Why would the passage treat self-sufficiency as a kind of loss?
questions.answer: Because it cuts a person off from the true source of strength and richness.

questions.question: What does the speaker renounce before asking for help from Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Dependence on personal power and ability.

questions.question: What sequence appears in the prayer after renouncing self-reliance?
questions.answer: First refuge is sought in Allah’s power, then trust in Him is requested, then protection and mercy are asked for.

questions.question: What does asking not to be left to ourselves suggest about human weakness?
questions.answer: People can easily fail if they rely only on themselves.

questions.question: Why is mercy requested not only for the speaker but also for believing men and women?
questions.answer: Because Islam teaches concern for the wider community of believers.

questions.question: In the passage, is Prophet Muhammad presented only as a historical figure or as someone with ongoing religious importance?
questions.answer: He is presented as someone with lasting religious importance because he is described as a guide, teacher, and mercy.

questions.question: Which titles show that Prophet Muhammad helps make Allah known to people?
questions.answer: The titles that describe him as explaining the signs, announcing what pleases Allah, and making known the treasures of the divine names.

questions.question: Which titles show honor and closeness rather than teaching alone?
questions.answer: The titles that describe him as servant, prophet, beloved, and friend.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest about the relationship between the Prophet and the Qur’anic message?
questions.answer: He is the one who conveys, explains, and reflects that guidance to people.

questions.question: Why are the Prophet’s family and companions mentioned with him?
questions.answer: To include those closely connected to him in the prayer for blessings and peace.

questions.question: What does the mention of angels and righteous servants add to the ending?
questions.answer: It gives the prayer a broad and heavenly scope.

questions.question: Summarize the message of the whole passage in one sentence.
questions.answer: It is a heartfelt du‘a asking Allah for guidance, dependence on Him, mercy, protection, and abundant blessings upon the Prophet and the righteous.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the best source of inner light?
questions.answer: It comes from belief and the Qur’an.

questions.question: How does the prayer present dependence on Allah: as weakness or as honor?
questions.answer: As honor and spiritual wealth.

questions.question: How does the prayer present imagined independence from Allah: as freedom or as loss?
questions.answer: As loss and inner poverty.

questions.question: What is the believer asking Allah to remove from his attitude toward himself?
questions.answer: Trust in his own separate strength and power.

questions.question: What is the believer asking Allah to replace that with?
questions.answer: Refuge in Allah’s power and the quality of trusting Him.

questions.question: What practical spiritual danger is mentioned by the line about not being entrusted to ourselves?
questions.answer: A person may go astray or fail when left to his own self.

questions.question: What two needs are directly asked from Allah for the community of believers?
questions.answer: Mercy and protection.

questions.question: What view of the Muslim community appears in the phrase about believing men and women?
questions.answer: The believing community includes both men and women and all are worthy of du‘a.

questions.question: What does the long praise of Prophet Muhammad help the reader understand about him?
questions.answer: It shows that he has many noble ranks and many roles in guiding people to Allah.

questions.question: Which description points to his role in uncovering the meaning of existence?
questions.answer: He is described as one who reveals the hidden meaning or mystery within created things.

questions.question: Which description points to his role in teaching people about Allah’s signs?
questions.answer: He is described as the one who explains those signs and teaches Allah’s servants.

questions.question: What is the importance of describing him as mercy for all worlds?
questions.answer: It shows that his mission is broad, compassionate, and not limited to one people.

questions.question: How does the ending reflect adab in making du‘a?
questions.answer: It includes prayers not just for oneself but also for the Prophet, his family, his companions, other prophets, angels, and righteous believers.
